verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same. Both make the headline huge and push it right up against the right column, so the period after 'sunshine.' nearly touches the CTA and the headline has very little margin at the top. Both shrink the 'See the Flavours' pill to a tiny button that is lost next to the headline. B's italic subline and button are slightly larger and easier to read than A's, which are cramped and small, so B is marginally less bad.
